responses.why: NARA holds the engrossed parchment in the Rotunda; public-domain scans of the object exist.
Iron-gall ink on the engrossed sheet has faded; Stone (1823) restores reading contrast, not the material surface.
Map-on-the-reverse is National Treasure (2004) plot invention, not an archival feature of the engrossed sheet.
Ottendorf/Silence Dogood treasure trail to Trinity vault is cinematic structure; era ciphers were real, this script is not.
Lemon juice/heat is film gimmick and unsafe for real artifacts — not conservation or scholarly method on the engrossed parchment.
Revolutionary-era invisible ink and cipher practice is real tradecraft history, separate from the movie map plot.
William J. Stone 1823 copperplate is a facsimile for legibility — not the Matlack engrossed Declaration object.
Stone flattens topography; iron-gall relief, grain, and fade maps live on RAW. Stone-only analysis loses material symbology.
Signature ductus and ink density variation are material marks best read on the engrossed RAW surface, not only the engraving.
Eye of Providence / pyramid is Great Seal / dollar-bill imagery — not drawn on the engrossed Declaration sheet.
Project doctrine: always pair RAW (material) + STONE (high-contrast reading). Cage-grade requires both panes.
Film fiction either way; Stone-only also violates the analysis hook — you lose the raw surface the movie pretends to chase.

doctrine: Always pair RAW (engrossed parchment) + STONE (1823 engraving).
